background: Bank of Scotland plc is one of the ring-fenced banks of Lloyds Banking Group, trading as Bank of Scotland and Halifax, funded by UK retail deposits and lending mainly on residential mortgages.
synthesis: Rated AA- on average across all three, the weakest of them at A+ and all three on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. CET1 of 14.1% is above the median for UK majors, but leverage of 4.5% is in the bottom quarter and is the figure to keep an eye on. Funding is adequate rather than generous: LCR of 144% sits at the median and NSFR of 123% is below it. CET1 has risen 0.7 points since 30 Jun 2024 with the other ratios broadly flat (figures to 30 Jun 2026), and the only item flagged in the last 90 days is the parent group's half-year result.
